hints.title: Frequency Tally
hints.text: Count the frequency of each string across the given collection.

hints.title: Order Preservation
hints.text: Iterate through the array in original order to identify distinct elements with frequency one.

hints.title: Rank Selection
hints.text: Return the k-th identified distinct string, or an empty string if fewer than k exist.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def kthDistinct(self, arr: list[str], k: int) -> str:
        counts = Counter(arr)
        distinct = [s for s in arr if counts[s] == 1]
        return distinct[k - 1] if k <= len(distinct) else ""
```

variables: N: number of strings in array
complexity.notes: Preserves the original appearance order when filtering distinct strings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops checking uniqueness take quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single frequency pass enables linear identification of distinct elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should distinguish between first-seen order and distinct occurrences.
